reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Since August 2026, billing dispute tickets have roughly doubled and stayed elevated (E-07: 590→1180→1260), driven primarily by the billing system mis-processing accepted ACTUAL meter reads into incorrect bills rather than by estimate substitution — 59% of disputed bills (1785/3025) carry an ACTUAL read type versus 41% ESTIMATED (E-03), tariff tables were unchanged (E-04), and ticket response handling is within SLA (E-02) — so the surge traces to a billing-processing defect on accepted reads, not response capacity or rate changes.
